title: Razorpay IPO: $7.5B → $5B — SEBI approved, listing 2027 | Fin Pulse
description:
Razorpay's IPO is finally here — SEBI approved.

Valued at $7.5 billion in 2021, the target is now $5 billion. IPO size: ₹5,000–6,000 crore. Expected listing: Jan–Mar 2027.

Key facts: Reverse flip completed (May 2025) · FY25 revenue ₹3,783 Cr (+65%) · Online payments EBITDA profitable · Fresh issue ₹2,700 Cr + OFS · Bankers: Axis, Kotak, JP Morgan, Citi.

This is educational content, not financial guidance. Always do your own research.
